title: NAFEMS LE1 elliptic membrane
sentence: An elliptical plate with an elliptical hole under outward pressure — the standard curved-boundary benchmark.
theory: LE1 exists to test curved boundaries: the quadratic elements put their mid-side nodes on the true ellipse, so the geometry is represented to second order rather than by chords. The target is the tangential stress $\sigma_{yy} = 92.7\,\mathrm{MPa}$ at point D on the inner ellipse.
